sections.title: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene
sections.abstract: The authors report incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene.
sections.caveat: “Incipient” superconductivity is not a demonstrated zero-resistance bulk state.

sections.title: 100 million photons per second from a single organic molecule
sections.abstract: A cryogenic antenna yields 100 million photons/s with 97% collection efficiency.
sections.claimed_result: A cryogenic antenna yields 100 million photons/s with 97% collection efficiency.
sections.caveat: Scaling beyond the demonstrated molecule and cryogenic geometry remains open.

sections.title: Design Principles for Ultra-High-Rate Quantum Codes
sections.abstract: The paper develops compact high-rate code constructions and identifies rate-distance-check-weight tradeoffs.
sections.claimed_result: The paper develops compact high-rate code constructions and identifies rate-distance-check-weight tradeoffs.
sections.caveat: Hardware, decoder, and measurement overheads are not experimentally established.

sections.title: Syndrome measurements enable deterministic fault-tolerant T gates
sections.abstract: The authors propose deterministic logical T gates mediated by syndrome measurement and feed-forward.
sections.claimed_result: The authors propose deterministic logical T gates mediated by syndrome measurement and feed-forward.
sections.caveat: Claims depend on specified code constructions and circuit/noise models.

sections.title: A Narrow Neutrino Window for the LZ Event
sections.abstract: The paper proposes a two-step atmospheric-neutrino upscattering explanation for a 248 keV LZ recoil.
sections.claimed_result: The paper proposes a two-step atmospheric-neutrino upscattering explanation for a 248 keV LZ recoil.
sections.caveat: This is not evidence that the event has a neutrino or dark-sector origin.
